pr.title: [MM-72282] Stop polling for health_check jobs on servers without a Professional license
pr.description:
#### Summary
Every app server runs a health-check worker set with its own watcher. That watcher queried the Jobs table for pending `health_check` jobs every 15 seconds, and skipped the query only while the `HealthDashboard` feature flag was off. Without a Professional license, no `health_check` job can ever be created, because both the scheduler and Run now refuse. So each node on an unlicensed server ran 5,760 useless queries per day.

The fix gives the health-check watcher its own poll condition:
- `MakeJobTypeWatcher` takes an optional `shouldPoll func() bool`, checked before every poll.
- `health_check.MakeWorkers` takes a license function and passes `MinimumProfessionalLicense`. The app passes `Channels.License`.
- The worker's own `isEnabled` still checks only the feature flag. The workers framework starts and stops workers only at startup and on config changes, and installing a license is not a config change. If the license check were in `isEnabled`, a server started unlicensed would never start the worker, and every run would stay pending after a license was added. With this approach the worker goroutine stays running and idle, and only the query is skipped.

Tests:
- `TestWorkersWatcherSkipsPolling` covers no query when the flag is off, when there is no license, and when the license is below Professional.
- `TestHealthCheckWorkersPollOnlyWhileLicensed` runs against a real DB. It starts the workers unlicensed and checks they make no `health_check` query. It then adds a Professional license, with no restart and no config change, and checks that both a Run now job and a scheduler-created job are picked up and succeed. Finally it removes the license and checks that polling stops.
- I confirmed both tests fail when the poll condition is disabled.

QA steps:
1. Start a server with no license and with `MM_FEATUREFLAGS_ENABLEMATTERMOSTENTRY=false`, so it doesn't fall back to an Entry license. Turn on Postgres `log_statement=all`.
2. Check that no `SELECT ... FROM Jobs WHERE Status = 'pending' AND Type = 'health_check'` appears in the Postgres log. Before this fix, one appeared every 15 seconds.
3. Upload a Professional or higher license in System Console > Edition and License, without restarting the server. The query now appears every 15 seconds.
4. In System Console > Site health, click **Re-run checks**. The run completes and the page shows "Last evaluated just now".

#### Ticket Link
Fixes: https://mattermost.atlassian.net/browse/MM-72282

#### Screenshots
**Before (master):** an unlicensed server polls for `health_check` jobs every 15 seconds.

https://cursor-plugin-pr-assets.s3.amazonaws.com/cursor/MM-72282-health-check-poll-license/before-unlicensed-server-polls-health-check-jobs.mp4

[Postgres log, before](https://cursor-plugin-pr-assets.s3.amazonaws.com/cursor/MM-72282-health-check-poll-license/before-unlicensed-health-check-polling.log)

**After (this branch):** no polls while unlicensed. Polling starts as soon as a license is uploaded
